papers.title: The Benefit of Multitask Representation Learning
papers.findings: Theorem1 fixed-task product sampling; Theorem2 additionally iid environment tasks. Bounded Lipschitz scalar loss and task average; oracle excess-risk proof uses global ERM, uniform Theorem13 does not require ERM. Zero-origin conditions are technical, not a decisive obstruction.
papers.limits: Selected definitions/theorems and MTL proof scope only. PDFp20 proof/tools opening; experimental plot visible but not audited. No complete experiments, full LTL proof, reproduction or publisher-final certification. JMLR v(yyyy)/copyright yyyy on title page are placeholders.

papers.title: Vector valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and universality
papers.findings: Operator-valued positive-definite kernels and feature-map factorization, Prop1 PDFp6. Proposition explicitly credits prior[6]; no novelty or complete standalone proof attributed to this paper.
papers.limits: Selected intro/definitions/feature-map statement pp1-7 only. Universality/Bochner/POVM/translation-invariant results and later proofs not read or transferred.
